Messages.Author: thelonius reloaded
Messages.Body:
Greetings fellow methuselahs!

It's an honor and a pleasure to announce that Grand Prix Tour 2019 will start very soon, and to uphold our traditions, Italy will be the first in line to host the event!

Our beloved Baron wants you to join us in Bologna, in the northern part of the country, on Sunday 2nd of December.

Saturday, December 1st: Friendly warm up tournament II
[event not yet created]
Meet new friends and bleed them to death!
Tournament format: Standard constructed
Entry Fee: 8,00€
Round: 3+final
Starting time around 11.00 am (tba)
Door prize: tba
Proxy: allowed
Prizes: tba

Sunday, December 2nd: THE GRAND PRIX!
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/9060
Tournament format: Standard constructed
Entry Fee: 15,00€
Round: 3+final
Starting time around 10.00 am
Door prize: tba
Proxy: not allowed
Prizes: tba

Both tournament will be held in:
Circolo Arci Benassi
viale Sergio Cavina 4
40139 Bologna (BO)

( www.google.com/maps/place/Viale+Sergio+Cavina,+4,+40139+Bologna+BO,+Italia/@44.470959,11.39433,15z/data=!4m5!3m4!1s0x477e2b04efa6cb01:0x84699deff4ee540d!8m2!3d44.473236!4d11.3959937?hl=it-IT )

We hope to see you in December! Feel free to ask (almost) anything here and/or via e-mail at simone.zanni at gmail dot com

Lurking in the underground of Bologna, Italy

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=10156021596639150&id=20712459149

"The V:EKN and Black Chantry Productions are proud to announce that game accessory manufacturers Ultra Pro are sponsoring the 2018-2019 Vampire European Grand Prix circuit. For all the events in the circuit, the company will provide for attendance prize of unique V:TES Playmat designed solely for the European Grand Prix circuit. So attending at least one of the five GP tournaments will give you one copy of the wickedly evil V:TES playmat featuring Evil Jensen.

The playmats, designed by our own Ginés Quiñonero Santiago with art by Chad Michael Ward, will be coming from printers in spring 2019, but participants of this weekend's Italian Grand Prix in Bologna will get their playmats, even if some months after the actual event."

To make it clear, this is a participation prize and thus everyone attending a GP tournament will get one. How cool is that!?

Now there is no reason not to attend a GP!
